Diagnostic tables of the fishery truth

Source: R/fishery_diagnostics.R
fishery_diagnostics.Rd

Tables written by Experimento 02 in outputs/diagnostics/: fleet structure, regional presence, hooks and HBF quantiles by decade, strategy frequency, catch summaries, mean catchability by factor (the truth a standardisation tries to recover), nominal CPUE vs true biomass (global or by factor; for regions the reference is the regional biomass) and its log-log slopes (beta < 1 indicates hyperstability), species composition and the recovery of the latent strategy from the catch composition (k-means and PCA, a check that the generator leaves the signature that a cluster / DPC approach looks for).

Usage

fleet_structure_table(td, vessels, trips)

regional_presence_table(td)

effort_summary_table(td)

hbf_summary_table(td)

strategy_frequency_table(td)

catch_summary_table(td, by = "Fleet")

catchability_summary_table(td, hbf_breaks = c(3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 26))

cpue_biomass_table(td, truth, by = NULL)

cpue_biomass_slopes(tab)

species_composition_table(td, cfg, by = "TrueFishingStrategy")

strategy_recovery_diagnostic(td, cfg)

Arguments

td

True fishery data ($data of an om_fishery object).

vessels, trips

Vessel and trip tables of the om_fishery object.

by

Grouping column.

hbf_breaks

Breaks of the HBF classes.

truth

Population truth (fishery_truth()).

tab

Output of cpue_biomass_table().

cfg

Fishery configuration.

Value

A data frame (or a list for strategy_recovery_diagnostic()).
